cond_0001.intro:
The Division of Cardiovascular Medicine, within [Company name masked] Department of Medicine, is dedicated to research, medical education, and clinical care. Our Division is driven by over 90 faculty members and a cadre of staff who are the pillar of strength in the Division's ongoing efforts into the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease.
We are seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator Associate (CRCA) to work with a robust clinical research team, hand in hand with Principal Investigators, Clinical Research Managers, Associates and other stakeholders in support of patients with lymphedema and other lymphatic disorders.
The Clinical Research Coordinator Associate will be responsible for the overall implementation of an assigned set of research protocols assuring efficiency and regulatory compliance. Other responsibilities will include recruiting, screening, assisting in the informed consent process and enrolling subjects in accordance with good clinical practice guidelines as well as collecting, recording and maintaining complete data files using good clinical practice in accordance with HIPAA regulations. The CRCA will participate in data retrieval, reporting, and preparation of files and Case Report Forms for the various studies. Other duties may include processing of blood samples, reporting serious adverse events and maintenance of drug accountability, supplies and equipment.
CV Med Clinical Research is a growing team dedicated to supporting translational medicine and contributing to [Company name masked]'s mission. We invite you to join our team!
cond_0001.responsibilities: Serve as primary contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies. Coordinate studies from start-up through close-out. Determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol. Assist in developing recruitment strategies. Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects. Manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms. Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents. Prepare regulatory submissions, and ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed. Assemble study kits for study visits, monitor scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, acting as primary contact. Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets and resolve billing issues in collaboration with finance and/or management staff. Interact with the principal investigator regularly, ensuring patient safety and adherence to proper study conduct. Ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements. Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Two year college degree and two years related work experience, or a Bachelor's degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of related education and relevant experience.
Strong interpersonal skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Knowledge of medical terminology.
Preferred Requirements
1-2 Years of additional clinical trial experience.
Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0030.intro:
The Division of Cardiovascular Medicine, within [Company name masked] Department of Medicine, is a dynamic and innovative center dedicated to excellence in research, medical education, and clinical care. Our Division is driven by over 90 faculty members and a cadre of staff who are the pillar of strength in the Division's ongoing efforts into the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease.
We are seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator Associate (CRCA) who is passionate about clinical research and wants to deliver results. The CRCA will work with a robust clinical research team, hand in hand with Principal Investigators, Clinical Research Managers, Associates and other stakeholders in support of patients with lymphedema and other lymphatic disorders.
The Clinical Research Coordinator Associate will be responsible for the overall implementation of an assigned set of research protocols assuring efficiency and regulatory compliance. Other responsibilities will include recruiting, screening, assisting in the informed consent process and enrolling subjects in accordance with good clinical practice guidelines as well as collecting, recording and maintaining complete data files using good clinical practice in accordance with HIPAA regulations. The CRCA will participate in data retrieval, reporting, and preparation of files and Case Report Forms for the various studies. Other duties may include processing of blood samples, reporting serious adverse events and maintenance of drug accountability, supplies and equipment.
CV Med Clinical Research is a growing, dynamic team who is dedicated to supporting translational medicine and contributing to [Company name masked]'s mission. If you are eager to quickly achieve lasting results, we invite you to join our team!
cond_0030.responsibilities: Serve as primary contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies. Coordinate studies from start-up through close-out. Determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol. Assist in developing recruitment strategies. Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects. Manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms. Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents. Prepare regulatory submissions, and ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed. Assemble study kits for study visits, monitor scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, acting as primary contact. Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets and resolve billing issues in collaboration with finance and/or management staff. Interact with the principal investigator regularly, ensuring patient safety and adherence to proper study conduct. Ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements. Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits.
cond_0030.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience; around 1–2 years of clinical trial experience is helpful but not required.
Two-year college degree and two years of related work experience, or a Bachelor's degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Ability to communicate and work well with others.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
Some background in medical terminology is useful; willingness to build on this knowledge is welcome.
Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification is preferred, or a willingness to obtain certification.
Physical Requirements
Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping. cond_0037.intro:
The Division of Cardiovascular Medicine, within [Company name masked] Department of Medicine, is dedicated to research, medical education, and clinical care. Our Division is driven by over 90 faculty members and a cadre of staff who are the pillar of strength in the Division's ongoing efforts into the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease.
We are seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator Associate (CRCA) to work with a robust clinical research team, hand in hand with Principal Investigators, Clinical Research Managers, Associates and other stakeholders in support of patients with lymphedema and other lymphatic disorders.
The Clinical Research Coordinator Associate will be responsible for the overall implementation of an assigned set of research protocols assuring efficiency and regulatory compliance. Other responsibilities will include recruiting, screening, assisting in the informed consent process and enrolling subjects in accordance with good clinical practice guidelines as well as collecting, recording and maintaining complete data files using good clinical practice in accordance with HIPAA regulations. The CRCA will participate in data retrieval, reporting, and preparation of files and Case Report Forms for the various studies. Other duties may include processing of blood samples, reporting serious adverse events and maintenance of drug accountability, supplies and equipment.
CV Med Clinical Research is a growing team dedicated to supporting translational medicine and contributing to [Company name masked]'s mission. We invite you to join our team!
cond_0037.responsibilities: Serve as primary contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies. Coordinate studies from start-up through close-out. Determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol. Assist in developing recruitment strategies. Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects. Manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms. Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents. Prepare regulatory submissions, and ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed. Assemble study kits for study visits, monitor scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, acting as primary contact. Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets and resolve billing issues in collaboration with finance and/or management staff. Interact with the principal investigator regularly, ensuring patient safety and adherence to proper study conduct. Ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements. Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits.

Strong interpersonal skills.

Preferred Requirements

Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification.

cond_0123.intro:
The Division of Cardiovascular Medicine, within [Company name masked] Department of Medicine, is dedicated to research, medical education, and clinical care. Our Division is driven by over 90 faculty members and a cadre of staff who are the pillar of strength in the Division's ongoing efforts into the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease.
We are seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator Associate (CRCA) who will work closely and regularly with a robust clinical research team, including Principal Investigators, Clinical Research Managers, Associates, and other stakeholders in support of patients with lymphedema and other lymphatic disorders.
The CRCA will be responsible for the overall implementation of an assigned set of research protocols assuring efficiency and regulatory compliance. This includes recruiting, screening, assisting in the informed consent process, and enrolling subjects in accordance with good clinical practice guidelines, as well as collecting, recording, and maintaining complete data files in accordance with HIPAA regulations. The CRCA will participate in data retrieval, reporting, and preparation of files and Case Report Forms for various studies. Other duties may include processing blood samples, reporting serious adverse events, and maintenance of drug accountability, supplies, and equipment.
CV Med Clinical Research is a growing team dedicated to supporting translational medicine and contributing to [Company name masked]'s mission. We invite you to join our team!
cond_0123.responsibilities:
Serve as primary contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies, communicating regularly and handling questions as they arise.
Coordinate studies from start-up through close-out.
Determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol.
Assist in developing recruitment strategies, actively connecting with potential participants.
Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects.
Manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study-related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms.
Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents.
Prepare regulatory submissions, and ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed.
Assemble study kits for study visits, monitor scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, acting as primary contact.
Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets and resolve billing issues in collaboration with finance and/or management staff.
Interact with the principal investigator regularly, ensuring patient safety and adherence to proper study conduct.
Ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements.
Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits.

Our Division is supported by over 90 faculty members and a cadre of staff who are central to ongoing efforts in the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease.
We are looking for a Clinical Research Coordinator Associate (CRCA) to work alongside a robust clinical research team, coordinating closely with Principal Investigators, Clinical Research Managers, Associates, and other stakeholders in support of patients with lymphedema and other lymphatic disorders.
The CRCA will work with the team on the overall implementation of an assigned set of research protocols, helping to ensure efficiency and regulatory compliance. This includes supporting recruitment, screening, and the informed consent process, enrolling subjects in accordance with good clinical practice guidelines, and collaborating on the collection, recording, and maintenance of complete data files in accordance with HIPAA regulations. The CRCA will participate in data retrieval, reporting, and preparation of files and Case Report Forms across various studies. Other shared duties may include processing blood samples, reporting serious adverse events, and helping maintain drug accountability, supplies, and equipment.
[Company name masked] Clinical Research is a growing team dedicated to supporting translational medicine. We invite you to join us.
cond_0297.responsibilities:
Serve as a shared point of contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies.
Coordinate studies from start-up through close-out in collaboration with the broader team.
Work with study staff to determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol.
Help develop recruitment strategies alongside investigators and coordinators.
Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects together with team members.
Manage research project databases, and work with colleagues to develop flow sheets and other study-related documents; complete study documents and case report forms.
Help ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents.
Coordinate regulatory submissions and work with the team to ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed.
Assemble study kits for study visits, support scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors as a shared point of contact.
Work with finance and management staff to monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets and help resolve billing issues.
Coordinate regularly with the principal investigator to support patient safety and adherence to proper study conduct.
Help ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements.
Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits alongside the team.
cond_0297.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Two-year college degree and two years of related work experience, or a Bachelor's degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of related education and relevant experience.
Strong interpersonal skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Knowledge of medical terminology.
Preferred Requirements
An additional 1–2 years of clinical trial experience.
Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification.
Physical Requirements
Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping. Occasionally sit, reach above shoulders, perform desk based computer tasks, use a telephone and write by hand, lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh up to 40 pounds. Rarely kneel, crawl, climb ladders, grasp forcefully, sort and file paperwork or parts, rarely lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh 40 pounds or more.
Working Conditions
Position may at times require the employee to work with or be in areas where hazardous materials and/or exposure to chemicals, blood, body fluid or tissues and risk of exposure to contagious diseases and infections. May require extended or unusual work hours based on research requirements and business needs. Will be working at [Location masked] sites.
Work Standards
Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates the ability to work well with [Company name masked] colleagues and clients and with external organizations. Promote Culture of Safety: Demonstrates commitment to personal responsibility and value for safety; communicates safety concerns; uses and promotes safe behaviors based on training and lessons learned. Subject to and expected to comply with all applicable University policies and procedures, including but not limited to the personnel policies and other policies found in the University's Administrative Guide.

cond_0328.intro:
The Division of Cardiovascular Medicine, within [Company name masked] Department of Medicine, is a dynamic and innovative center dedicated to excellence in research, medical education, and clinical care. Our Division is driven by over 90 faculty members and a cadre of staff who are the pillar of strength in the Division's ongoing efforts into the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease.
We are seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator Associate (CRCA) who is passionate about clinical research and wants to deliver results. The CRCA will work with a robust clinical research team, hand in hand with Principal Investigators, Clinical Research Managers, Associates and other stakeholders in support of patients with lymphedema and other lymphatic disorders.
The Clinical Research Coordinator Associate will be responsible for the overall implementation of an assigned set of research protocols assuring efficiency and regulatory compliance. Other responsibilities will include recruiting, screening, assisting in the informed consent process and enrolling subjects in accordance with good clinical practice guidelines as well as collecting, recording and maintaining complete data files using good clinical practice in accordance with HIPAA regulations. The CRCA will participate in data retrieval, reporting, and preparation of files and Case Report Forms for the various studies. Other duties may include processing of blood samples, reporting serious adverse events and maintenance of drug accountability, supplies and equipment.
CV Med Clinical Research is a growing, dynamic team dedicated to supporting translational medicine and contributing to [Company name masked]'s mission. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the regulatory and data management logic that clinical research involves. If you are eager to quickly achieve lasting results, we invite you to join our team!
cond_0328.responsibilities: Serve as primary contact with research participants, sponsors, and regulatory agencies. Coordinate studies from start-up through close-out. Determine eligibility of and gather consent from study participants according to protocol. Assist in developing recruitment strategies. Collect and manage patient and laboratory data for clinical research projects. Manage research project databases, develop flow sheets and other study related documents, and complete study documents/case report forms. Ensure compliance with research protocols, and review and audit case report forms for completion and accuracy with source documents. Prepare regulatory submissions, and ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed. Assemble study kits for study visits, monitor scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinate documents, and attend monitoring meetings with sponsors, acting as primary contact. Monitor expenditures and adherence to study budgets and resolve billing issues in collaboration with finance and/or management staff. Interact with the principal investigator regularly, ensuring patient safety and adherence to proper study conduct. Ensure essential documentation and recording of patient and research data in appropriate files per institutional and regulatory requirements. Participate in monitor visits and regulatory audits.

cond_0470.intro:
The Division of Cardiovascular Medicine, within [Company name masked] Department of Medicine, is a dynamic and innovative center dedicated to excellence in research, medical education, and clinical care. Our Division is driven by over 90 faculty members and a cadre of staff who are the pillar of strength in the Division's ongoing efforts into the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular disease.
We are seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator Associate (CRCA) who is passionate about clinical research and wants to deliver results. The CRCA will work with a robust clinical research team, hand in hand with Principal Investigators, Clinical Research Managers, Associates and other stakeholders in support of patients with lymphedema and other lymphatic disorders.
The Clinical Research Coordinator Associate will be responsible for the overall implementation of an assigned set of research protocols assuring efficiency and regulatory compliance. Other responsibilities will include recruiting, screening, assisting in the informed consent process and enrolling subjects in accordance with good clinical practice guidelines as well as collecting, recording and maintaining complete data files using good clinical practice in accordance with HIPAA regulations. The CRCA will participate in data retrieval, reporting, and preparation of files and Case Report Forms for the various studies. Other duties may include processing of blood samples, reporting serious adverse events and maintenance of drug accountability, supplies and equipment.
CV Med Clinical Research is a growing, dynamic team who is dedicated to supporting translational medicine and contributing to [Company name masked]'s mission. If you are eager to quickly achieve lasting results, we invite you to join our team!

Advanced knowledge of medical terminology.
Preferred Requirements
Society of Clinical Research Associates (SoCRA) or Association of Clinical Research Professionals (ACRP) certification.
